versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-flight (flightAI) skill.
- Enables domestic flight search, fare detail query, booking, order management, flight change, and refunds.
- Requires user authentication via mobile verification before any operation.
- All functions triggered via command-line Python scripts; supports full booking, change, refund, and detail retrieval processes.
- Includes privacy notice for handling personal information during booking.

flightAI 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides AI-powered assistant for searching, booking, rescheduling, and refunding domestic flights in China.
- Supports full flow: user authentication, flight & seat search, booking, order detail, cancellation, rescheduling, and refunds.
- Requires python3 environment for executing API scripts.
- Ensures sensitive information (name, phone, ID) only sent to flight service, not exposed in responses or logs.
- Offers detailed command-line examples, user guidance, and strict context parameter checks.
- Chinese-language prompts and scenarios included for frictionless customer experience.
